snippet.title: Truth Scrapper 📚 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Truth Scrapper is insertdisc5's next game!!!

You have a case to solve, your memories reset each day, and two mysterious guides are vying for your attention– who will you decide to remember, and who will you decide to push aside…? 

Truth Scrapper is a mystery/romance visual novel and it's very good and you should wishlist it so you can get all the news

Wishlist on Steam 📚 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239830/Truth_Scrapper/

Animation 📚 https://mikesscibbles.squarespace.com/
Trailer Edit 📚 https://continueagency.com/
Soundtrack 📚 https://www.castleif.com/
